title: Jacobians in abelian-threefold isogeny classes
exact_target: Decide which finite-field isogeny classes of abelian threefolds contain an actual genus-three Jacobian over that field.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8800046 (AMR-087-0046). CC BY 4.0.
